QuestInfo.name: Breaking the Force Field
QuestInfo.0: I wanted to go deep inside the temple, but I couldn't because of the intruder's force field.  I should try making the item that can destroy the force field with help from #p2140000#.
QuestInfo.1: In order to make the #t4032002#, the item that can destroy the force field, you need #b10 Smiley Masks, 10 #t4000451#s, 10 #t4000456#s, and 1 of each of the following: #t4000460#, #t4000461# and #t4000462##k.  All these items are only found in the Temple of Time.
QuestInfo.2: When I brought all the ingredients to #p2140000#, he made me the #t4032002#.  Now I should be able to go deep inside the temple again.

0.0: The force field has reappeared at the deepest part of the temple? The intruder must've put it up again... This just shows that the intruder's powers have not weakened. We'll have to make another #t4032002# to break down the force field again.

yes.0: You already know all the ingredients, right? 10 #b#t4000446#, 10 #t4000451#, 10 #t4000456##k and #b1 each of #t4000460#, #t4000461# and #t4000462##k. Bring me those and I will make you another #b#t4032002##k.

no.0: If you're not planning to go in, you won't need the marble either.

1.0: You got all the ingredients. I will combine the ingredients and make you the #t4032002#.

yes.0: The #t4032002# should be able to destroy the force field. However, you can only use it once and it'll last only for a short period of time. Remember, if you need to go in again, you'll have to make another #t4032002#.

item.0: You didn't get all the ingredients yet? Go to the #rPriest and Memory Monk Trainee#k and get #b10 #t4000446##k, go to the #rPriest and Qualm Monk Trainee#k and get #b10 #t4000451##k, go to the #rPriest and Oblivion Monk Trainee#k and get #b10 #t4000456##k, go to #r#o8220004##k and get #b#t4000460##k, go to #r#o8220005##k and get #b#t4000461##k, and finally go to #r#o8220006##k and get #b#t4000462##k.
